stories.headline: Supreme Court overturns Liberal one-vote election win in Terrebonne
stories.summary: The Supreme Court of Canada annulled Liberal MP Tatiana Auguste's single-vote victory in Terrebonne after a Bloc Québécois challenge, requiring a new by-election. The ruling stems from a mail-in ballot error that affected one voter's ballot during the April 2025 election.

stories.headline: Bloc Québécois renews push for seniors' pension equity
stories.summary: The Bloc introduced a new version of its bill demanding equal pension treatment for seniors aged 65-74, who currently receive 10% less than those 75 and older. The party calls this age-based discrimination and seeks to eliminate the two-tier system affecting over one million Quebecers.
